name: Lord of the Rings

date.source: The fed's own News page (27 January 1999) names the show as a NeWA-hub PPV with two Mid-Atlantic matches submitted to it, without giving a date of its own.

evidence.note: The fed's own News page (27 January 1999): "At the NeWA PPV, Lord of the Rings, I have submitted 2 matches from the Mid-Atlantic" — a hub-wide PPV, not this territory's own card, with no result page or further mention held anywhere in the wing's own record.

appearances.note: Billed as Mid-Atlantic Champion against "EWC" Television Champion HICAL, winner to take both belts and a shot at the NeWA World Champion or the NeWA International Champion "when they come through the Mid and North Atlantic."
Billed as "EWC T.V Champion" against Mid-Atlantic Champion Lycos, in the same unification stakes.

Ordered to defend the Mid-Atlantic Tag Team Championship, opponent "named at match time" — Jim Crockett, Jr.'s own News page frames it as a forced defense ("have you sen them put the belts up, even once since Crowing Event?" [sic]).

notes: No held document says this PPV took place, or names any result for either submitted match; the fed's own Title History page's next attested changes (10 February 1999, all three titles named here) do not name this show as the occasion.
